messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — LuminaHealth is hitting the 90th percentile of their monthly quota early (spike starting 03/17). Thinking we should do a proactive comms + temporary limit increase. Anyone on deck to sprint this?

aj_sales: Saw that in the dashboard this morning. Renewal conversation next month; want to avoid surprises. I can loop in the AE after we have a comms plan.

sam_engineer: Quick check — what's spiking (embeddings vs gen)? Also can we do model fallback to a smaller variant to preserve latency and cost?

maria_cs: Mostly text-gen (chat completions) — average tokens/session up x2 due to a new feature they're A/B testing. Latency is fine but errors slight uptick.

sam_engineer: OK. Proposed plan: 1) temporary soft quota bump for this month (+20%); 2) enable automatic fallback to redwood-medium on non-critical routes; 3) add prefix caching for repeat prompts. I can enable fallback by EOD if approvals in.

oliver_support: I'll draft the customer note + in-product banner. Tone: proactive, short, offer help + suggested mitigations. Also prep a public FAQ blurb for the KB.

karen_ops: For the quota bump I need a ticket with cust id, current limit, requested bump, and owner. Maria, can you post those here? Ops needs approval chain: finance -> infra.

maria_cs: LuminaHealth (acct: LH-9823), current monthly token cap: 5M, usage this month: 4.6M and trending. Requesting +1M temporary increase for March only. Owner: maria_cs.

aj_sales: I'll be AE copy/paste on the comms and follow during renewal. If they accept bump, we should include a note about optimizing prompts — offer a short enablement session.

sam_engineer: Fallback config (ready to push):
```json
{"route_pattern":"/chat/noncritical","primary":"redwood-large","fallback":"redwood-medium","threshold_ms":1200}
```
I also recommend setting the per-route burst cap to 200rps for safety.

oliver_support: Draft banner copy: "Heads-up: We've temporarily increased your API capacity while you run tests. Contact your CS if you need help optimizing usage. — Redwood". I'll attach CTA link to an enablement calendar.

notify-bot: Scheduled banner creation job queued (job id: jb-1179). Expected deploy in 12 minutes.

karen_ops: Filed ops ticket OPS-3917 with bump request and approval workflow. Tagging finance for sign-off.

maria_cs: Action items: maria_cs = send bump request (done), oliver = publish banner + KB (in flight), sam = enable fallback and set burst cap after ops OK, aj = coordinate AE messaging and offer enablement. I'll follow up tomorrow in the 10am sync. :thumbsup:

aj_sales: +1. Also will prepare a short slide on how fallback affects latency/quality for the renewal call.

sam_engineer: Will test fallback in staging now and post quick perf numbers here.

oliver_support: Email draft ready — dropping into the thread in 5.

maria_cs: Thanks team — keeping this as a proactive reach to avoid any throttles.

notify-bot: Reminder set for 2026-03-18T10:00:00Z for account-health follow-up (reminder id: r-5543).
_meta: generated for dataset: slack threads about proactive quota/limit comms — single-thread JSON with metadata
